narrative_text:
The causal model identified an Average Treatment Effect (ATE) of +0.0049 — meaning a discount increases purchase probability by 0.5 percentage points on average.

Out of 64,000 customers analysed:
  • 3,778 are Persuadables (5.9%) — the best targets for discounts.
  • 60,222 are Sure Things — likely to buy without a discount.
  • 60,222 are Lost Causes — discounts are wasted on them.
  • 0 are Sleeping Dogs — discounts may discourage purchase.

Targeting only Persuadables is estimated to generate $26,761.48 in incremental revenue, compared to $15,577.19 under random targeting — a saving of $11,184.29.
